statement: ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → ∀ k : ℤ, Continuous (fun t : ℝ => KdVPlan.B t f g k)
proof:
intro f g hf hg k
have hn : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (j : ℤ), ‖KdVPlan.S t f j‖ = ‖f j‖ := by
  intro t f j
  change ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((t * (j : ℝ)^3 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * f j‖ = _
  rw [norm_mul, mul_comm Complex.I, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
have hs : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∑' j : ℤ, KdVPlan.S t f j * KdVPlan.S t g (k-j)) := by
  apply continuous_tsum (u := fun j => ‖f j‖ * ‖g (k-j)‖)
  · intro j
    unfold KdVPlan.S
    fun_prop
  · exact yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 f g hf hg k
  · intro j t
    rw [norm_mul, hn, hn]
change Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((-t * (k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (∑' j : ℤ, KdVPlan.S t f j * KdVPlan.S t g (k-j))))
exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((-t * (k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ) : ℂ)))).mul (continuous_const.mul hs)
